name: Terrorists
overview: Scripture reveals that God hears the humble and establishes their hearts amid threats and fear, offering comfort even in the darkest valleys where evil seems present. Believers are called to depart from evil, seek peace, and avoid violence, as God hates actions that lead to harm and destruction. Jesus instructs that those who live by the sword will perish by it, emphasizing the call to trust God's protection rather than resorting to violence. This teaches that God’s people should rely on His guidance and pursue peace, rejecting the terror and violence associated with those who cause harm.
